title: Entrance Fee Agreement Terms for Cancellation Before Occupancy and the Occupancy Deadline
content:
Terms of the **Entrance Fee Agreement** for an agreement that ends after the rescission period but before the resident takes occupancy, and for the occupancy deadline and its extension.

## Article 1. Cancellation by the resident
After the rescission period and before occupancy the resident may cancel by signed notice.

> Retired clause, no longer in force: the clause that a processing fee of the plan's pre-occupancy cancellation fee percentage of the entrance fee, rounded to the cent half up, is retained. This clause is superseded by the current basis for the processing fee of a cancellation before occupancy.

> Retired clause, no longer in force: the clause that the rest of the money paid is refunded no later than the plan's pre-occupancy refund period, in calendar days, after the cancellation. This clause is superseded by the current basis for the refund on a resident's own cancellation before occupancy.

A pre-occupancy cancellation by the resident must be signed by the resident or by a representative whose authority on the customer profile is a financial power of attorney, a durable power of attorney or a guardianship.

## Article 2. Death, illness or injury before occupancy
Where the resident dies before occupancy, or a physician certifies in writing that illness or injury prevents the resident from occupying the apartment, the agreement is cancelled with the cancellation reason death or illness before occupancy, no processing fee is retained and the plan's health refund percentage of the money paid is refunded, to the estate after a death. A death before occupancy is evidenced only by the date of death on the customer profile; a caller's statement of a death is not the evidence.

## Article 3. Occupancy deadline and extension
Occupancy must take place within the plan's occupancy deadline after signing. On the resident's request before that deadline the planned occupancy date may be extended by the plan's extension length, at most the plan's maximum number of extensions. An occupancy extension may be granted only while the agreement is in reserved status. A resident who neither occupies by the deadline nor obtains an extension is treated as cancelling before occupancy on the deadline date.

## Points of judgement

| Situation before occupancy | Basis |
|---|---|
| Resident signs a cancellation after the rescission period | Article 1 |
| Date of death on the customer profile | Article 2, refund to the estate |
| Physician's written certification that illness or injury prevents occupancy | Article 2 |
| Deadline passes with no occupancy and no extension | Treated as a resident's cancellation on the deadline date |
| Extension requested while the agreement is reserved and before the deadline | May be granted, within the maximum |
| Extension requested once the agreement is no longer reserved | Not granted |
